The 18" machine-finished alloy wheels provide both visual appeal and durability, while the four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars contributes to composed handling. Electronic stability control and traction control work continuously to maintain grip, supported by four-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

This HR-V EX-L combines everyday practicality with refined touches in a compact package. The split-folding rear seat adapts to your cargo needs, whether you're managing weekend errands or weekend trips. Measuring practicality into the design, this Equinox includes a retractable cargo shade, rear window wiper, and split-folding rear seat to maximize your cargo flexibility.

Inside, the cabin reflects modern convenience and comfort. The driver enjoys an 8-way power seat with 2-way power lumbar adjustment, while both front occupants benefit from heated seats and a heated steering wheel for cold mornings. The dual-zone climate control allows you and your passengers to set individual temperature preferences, and the rain-sensing wipers automatically adjust to weather changes.

Technology integration keeps you connected and safe. The 11.3-inch touchscreen display powers the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 system, offering wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity. Wireless phone charging means your device stays powered throughout your journey, and the programmable universal home remote lets you control your garage and home automation directly from the vehicle.

The all-wheel-drive system delivers confident handling in varied conditions, while the 1.5L DOHC engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission achieves 25 city and 29 highway MPG. The fully independent four-wheel suspension, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to provide responsive and stable driving dynamics. Safety features include dual front impact airbags, side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and an emergency communication system.

This well-appointed Equinox represents a smart investment in daily driving comfort and reliability. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the refinement and practicality this vehicle offers for your lifestyle.

This 2027 Honda HR-V EX-L offers a compelling combination of versatility, comfort, and technology designed for buyers seeking a dependable compact crossover that handles daily driving with ease.

- Apple CarPlay

- Blind spot monitoring
- Front collision alert
- Heated seats

The 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine paired with a continuously variable transmission delivers capable performance while maintaining 26 city and 32 highway fuel economy. This powertrain strikes a practical balance, allowing you to handle daily commutes and weekend trips without frequent stops at the pump. The front-wheel-drive configuration provides confident handling in various weather conditions and road surfaces.

Inside the cabin, the EX-L trim emphasizes comfort and convenience. Heated front bucket seats with leather trim provide warmth during cold months, while the power-adjustable driver seat allows you to find your ideal driving position. The automatic dual-zone climate control keeps both front occupants at their preferred temperatures. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob enhance the upscale feel, and the telescoping steering column ensures proper positioning for drivers of different heights.

Safety and awareness features work together to support confident driving. The blind spot monitoring system alerts you to vehicles outside your direct view, while the front collision alert provides an additional layer of protection. The backup camera displays in your infotainment screen when reversing, making parking and maneuvering simpler. Electronic stability control and adaptive cruise control further support vehicle management on various road conditions.

Technology integration keeps you connected and informed. Apple CarPlay compatibility enables seamless smartphone integration, while the eight-speaker audio system with 180-watt output delivers quality sound for your drives. The steering wheel-mounted controls allow you to adjust audio, phone calls, and cruise settings without taking your hands from the wheel. The trip computer and compass provide useful navigation information, and the outside temperature display helps you prepare for weather conditions.

The HR-V's thoughtful design extends to practical conveniences like the power moonroof, which brings natural light and openness to the cabin. The rear window wiper and auto-dimming rear-view mirror enhance visibility in various conditions. Remote keyless entry and the security system provide easy access and peace of mind. The split-folding rear seat adapts your cargo space to accommodate everything from groceries to weekend gear.

This 2027 HR-V EX-L represents an opportunity to own a refined compact crossover that prioritizes both capability and comfort. With just 2 miles on the odometer, you're getting a virtually new vehicle ready for your ownership. Visit our showroom to experience the quality construction and intuitive controls that make this HR-V a smart choice for your next vehicle.

This 2019 GMC Sierra 1500 SLT combines capable performance with refined comfort, offering you a truck that handles both work and daily driving with confidence.

- SLT Premium Package with 20 polished aluminum wheels
- Chrome assist steps and chrome grille
- EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine with 4WD and 8-speed automatic transmission
- Premium GMC Infotainment System with multi-touch controls
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- SiriusXM satellite radio with HD Radio
- Heated and ventilated front seats with 10-way power adjustment and lumbar support
- Heated steering wheel
- Front dual zone automatic temperature control with rear window defroster
- Remote vehicle starter system with keyless open and start
- Heavy-duty rear locking differential with 3.23 rear axle ratio
- Integrated trailer brake controller with hitch guidance and in-vehicle trailering app
- 4-wheel disc ABS brakes with electronic stability and traction control
- OnStar and GMC Connected Services with 4G LTE

The Sierra 1500 SLT positions you in a driver's seat designed for long days of work or weekend adventures. The heated and ventilated front seats with memory settings keep you comfortable through changing seasons, while the heated steering wheel adds another layer of convenience during cold mornings. The 10-way power adjustable seats with lumbar support ensure you maintain proper posture whether you're commuting or spending hours behind the wheel.

Technology integrates seamlessly into your driving experience with the Premium GMC Infotainment System featuring a multi-touch display, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you manage functions without taking your hands off the wheel, and the SiriusXM satellite radio with HD Radio keeps you connected to your preferred content regardless of location.

For those who tow, this Sierra delivers purposeful capability. The integrated trailer brake controller works with the hitch guidance system to make connecting and backing up trailers more straightforward. The in-vehicle trailering app provides additional support, while the heavy-duty rear locking differential and auxiliary transmission oil cooler ensure reliable performance under load.

The exterior reflects the SLT Premium Package quality with 20 polished aluminum wheels, chrome assist steps, and a chrome grille that command attention. Power fog lights and fully automatic headlights with delay-off functionality provide visibility when you need it, while the power sliding rear window with defogger adds practical convenience to the bed area.

At 91,293 miles, this Sierra has established a solid service history while maintaining its capability and comfort features. The EcoTec3 5.3L V8 paired with the 8-speed automatic delivers 15 city MPG and 21 highway MPG, balancing power with efficiency for a full-size truck.

We invite you to schedule a time to see this Sierra 1500 SLT in person. You'll find a well-appointed truck ready to handle whatever you ask of it, backed by features that make every drive more enjoyable.

description:
This 2019 Toyota RAV4 Limited in white offers a well-rounded package of comfort, capability, and advanced features that make it an excellent choice for drivers seeking a reliable crossover.

- All Weather Floor Liners and Cargo Liner
- Height-Adjustable Power Liftgate with Foot Activation
- Wireless Phone Charger
- Panoramic View Monitor
- Panoramic Sunroof
- Wiper and Windshield Deicer
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats
- Rear Seat Heating
- Rain Sensing Front Wipers
- Leather Heated Steering Wheel
- Lane Departure Alert
- Entune 3.0 Premium Audio with JBL and Clari-Fi
- Apple CarPlay Compatibility
- Navigation System with Dynamic Voice Recognition
- Remote Keyless Entry

The RAV4 Limited is equipped with a 2.5L 4-cylinder engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, delivering practical performance with 25 city MPG and 33 highway MPG. This powertrain balances efficiency with capability, making it suitable for both daily commuting and weekend adventures.

The interior prioritizes driver comfort and convenience. Heated front and rear seats with ventilation in the front provide year-round comfort, while the leather-trimmed heated steering wheel adds an extra touch of refinement. The power-adjustable driver seat with memory function allows you to store your preferred seating position, and the panoramic sunroof creates an open, airy cabin atmosphere.

Technology integration is thoughtfully designed throughout this model. The Entune 3.0 Premium Audio system features an 8.0-inch touchscreen, 11 speakers strategically placed in nine locations, and a subwoofer for quality sound. Apple CarPlay compatibility ensures seamless smartphone integration, while hands-free phone capability and music streaming via Bluetooth keep you connected safely. The navigation system includes dynamic voice recognition and point-of-interest search functionality.

Safety and convenience features enhance your driving experience. The panoramic view monitor provides a comprehensive view around the vehicle, helping with parking and low-speed maneuvering. The available rear parking camera assists with backup visibility. Standard safety systems include multiple airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering for confident handling.

This RAV4 Limited combines practical everyday utility with refined comfort and technology, making it a versatile option for buyers seeking a dependable crossover with premium features and capabilities.

The heavy-duty rear locking differential and auxiliary transmission oil cooler support demanding work, while the 170-amp alternator ensures reliable power. The Silverado 1500 LTZ achieves 16 mpg city and 22 mpg highway with its 8-speed automatic transmission. Safety features include electronic stability control, traction control, dual front airbags, and side-impact airbags. The rear cross traffic alert and ultrasonic front and rear park assist help you navigate confidently in any situation.

This Silverado combines work-ready capability with daily-driver comfort. The exterior carries the signature Denali grille and premium touches throughout. GMC MultiPro Power Steps make entry easier, while chrome recovery hooks add both function and style. This 2019 Sierra 1500 Denali represents the full-size truck experience for those seeking a refined approach to capability and luxury. We invite you to schedule a test drive and discover how this truck can serve your needs.
